maya: just finished a regional sweep comparing A100 vs H100 for a set of common 7B-family models (llama2-7b, mixtral-lite, vicuna). focus: prefill + decode, q4 vs q8, and kernel choices (flash / fmha / tensorkernel). quick summary: H100 reduces decode latency ~20-35% and improves toks/sec, but $/1M tokens is not always better due to instance pricing differences. charts uploaded: https://redwood-gists/bench/1918769999 :bar_chart:
aj: nice. can you drop the raw numbers?
maya: pasted quick table below (rounded medians):
```
model | hw   | quant | prefill(ms) | decode(ms/token) | toks/sec | $/1M
llama2-7b | A100 | q4    | 120         | 2.6              | 380      | 12.6
llama2-7b | H100 | q4    | 95          | 1.9              | 520      | 15.8
mixtral-lite | A100 | q4 | 140         | 3.0              | 330      | 14.4
mixtral-lite | H100 | q4 | 110         | 2.1              | 470      | 17.2
vicuna-7b | A100 | q8     | 130         | 2.8              | 360      | 11.9
vicuna-7b | H100 | q8     | 100         | 2.0              | 500      | 14.7
```
sam: so H100 is lower latency but higher $/1M? that seems counterintuitive given throughput gains.
maya: yeah — throughput improved, but H100 vCPU + regional price premium pushes $/hour up. result: H100 wins for latency-sensitive, throughput-bound apps. A100 often wins for cost-sensitive, short-prefill or highly stateful workloads where prefill dominates.
leo: what about kernel choices? did flash-attention vs fused fmha change the ranking? any regression with q4?
maya: we ran three kernel configs. summary: flash gives best decode latency on H100 (esp for long decode steps), fmha is close on A100 for prefill-heavy runs. tensorkernel helps for q8 on mixtral but had slightly worse decode on llama2 long tail. no major quality regressions observed in logits; quantization sound for our eval prompts.
maya: command used to run sweep:
```
./bench.sh --model llama2-7b --hw a100,h100 --quant q4,q8 --kernels flash,fmha,tk --region us-west1,eu-west1 --prefill 128 --decode 256 --batch 8
```
ci-bot: Benchmark job 1918769999 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1918769999/{charts.csv,profiles.json,cost_breakdown.csv}. duration: 52m.
aj: can you push the H100 q4 decode profile? need to inspect KV-cache hot paths and kernel breakdown.
maya: pushed profile to s3 and gist. link: https://redwood-gists/bench/1918769999/h100-q4-decode-profile.json. also flagged a memory fragmentation OOM on H100 q8 in eu-west1 for mixtral-lite during prefill — repro steps in the artifact notes.
sam: any region-to-region perf variance?
maya: slight differences. us-west1 H100 has newer driver and shows ~5% better decode than eu-west1. A100 variance smaller but night/weekend noisy on shared pools. included per-region csv in artifacts.
leo: :thumbsup: recommendation for product: default PLG tier -> A100 + q4 (cost-conscious). latency-first plans -> H100 + q4. add routing fallback: route to A100 when H100 latency > threshold or capacity constrained. also suggest enabling flash kernel on H100 by default for decode flows.
maya: agreed. I'll open a PR to docs/ops with a config snippet and link to artifacts.
maya: suggested routing policy (will add to PR):
```
{
  "policy": "latency_preference",
  "primary": {"hw":"h100","quant":"q4"},
  "fallback": {"hw":"a100","quant":"q4"},
  "threshold_ms": 250
}
```
aj: sgtm. can you also include the $/1M calculation script?
maya: cost_calc.py and a short README are in the artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-bench/1918769999/cost_calc.py
sam: thanks — this is helpful. closing unless someone has blockers.
